source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of responsible data sharing (PDF 188).

blocks.text: Responsible data sharing (zimmedari se data share karna) ka matlab hai ke personal ya sensitive (nijji aur qeemti) maloomat sirf tab share karein jab bilkul zaroori ho, aur sirf trusted (bharose wale) organizations ya logon ke saath.

Misal: Pakistan mein online school scholarship ke liye apply karte waqt students apni personal details sirf secure aur verified (jin ki sachai check ho chuki ho) websites par dein, ta ke un ki maloomat ka ghalat istemal na ho.

blocks.prompt: Responsible data sharing maloomat ke ethical istemal mein kaise madad karti hai? (Short question 7)
blocks.explanation: Is mein sirf zaroori maloomat, sirf bharose wali organizations ko aur sirf mehfooz (secure, verified) websites par di jati hai. Is tarah logon ki privacy ki izzat hoti hai, maloomat ka ghalat istemal, dhoka aur chori ka khatra kam hota hai, aur data fair aur lawful tareeqe se sambhala jata hai, jo ethical use ki tareef hai.

items: Responsible data sharing: sirf zaroorat par, sirf bharose wali organizations ke saath, sirf secure websites par (scholarship ki misal).
